'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 1 Rick Moller DS Agents Of Black Sun''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Rick Moller]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince|Ref2-D-agentsofblacksun.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
